title.narrative: 2025 - SHF Reserve Allocation (Anticipatory cholera response in high-risk states ahead of the 2025 rainy season)

description.narrative: ltpgtThe IRC will strengthen the preparedness and response to the cholera outbreak in White Nile state, working closely with its local partner (CAFA Development Organization), the Ministry of Health (MoH), the WHO, UNICEF, the health cluster, nutrition cluster, and the WASH cluster. The IRC will focus on improving cholera case management at the cholera treatment centers (CTCs) in Kosti and Rabak localities through training of the healthcare workers on cholera case management, provision of cholera supplies and kits, as well as Daily Subsistence Allowance (DSA) to the health cadres deployed at the CTCs. The IRC, in collaboration with the MoH and the health cluster, will undertake supportive supervision to ensure the quality of the service delivery. Also, the IRC will strengthen rapid response teams (RRTs) through training and operational support in terms of provision of vehicles for field visits to respond to alerts and undertake investigations, provide DSA to the team members, and scale up risk communication and community engagement via working closely with the local partner to ensure community penetration and rapid impact. The IRC and CAFA will identify community health volunteers (CHVs), train the CHVs on community mobilization approaches, including cholera case definition, service delivery points and referral mechanisms. The IRC will work closely with the key stakeholders to reproduce and disseminate appropriate messages targeting risk factors to cut the chain of transmission. To ensure adequate coordination of all stakeholders engaged in the cholera preparedness and responses, the IRC will support the state cholera task force to effectively coordinate all response efforts, review data for decision making and advocate for resources and access to affected communities.lt/pgtltpgtThe IRC has a strong capacity in Sudan to strengthen cholera preparedness and responses in White Nile, Blue Nile, Khartoum, Gedaref and River Nile states. The IRC demonstrated its technical capacity in 2024 by supporting the state-level cholera task force in the River Nile state for three months, contributing to streamlined preparedness and response coordination. The IRC trained 88 healthcare workers on cholera case management and conducted rapid response team (RRT) trainings in two localities within River Nile State. Additionally, the IRC supported two RRTs in the River Nile state and three RRTs in the White Nile state by providing logistical support, including vehicles and refreshments, to enable effective community-level follow-up and response. In White Nile State, the IRC distributed 200 IEC materials and essential IPC supplies and has been working closely with the State Ministry of Health (SMoH) on cholera surveillance and contact tracing efforts. The IRC supported risk communication and community engagement, as well as capacity building for healthcare workers in Gedaref for cholera responses. The IRC has close working relations with the MoH and health cluster, facilitating timely and quality responses.lt/pgtltpgtGiven the current cholera situation in Sudan, and as of February 23, 2025, the White Nile state had the highest rate of cholera cases per 100k population among other surveyed states (WHO's Multi-Country Outbreak of Cholera situation report, March 20, 2025). The proposed interventions will address the urgent health and safety needs of IDPs, refugees and vulnerable host communities in Rabak and Kosti localities within the state. The IRC will prioritize critical pillars of cholera preparedness and response, complementing already existing action by the MoH, WHO, UNICEF, Plan International and Action Against Hunger (AAH). Following the conversion with the MoH and the health cluster as well as other partners on the ground, the IRC will prioritize the following pillars for response: Coordination, Disease Surveillance, Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE), Case Management, infection prevention and control, and logistics, equipment, and supplies support.ltbrgtlt/pgt
